verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm, so a client portal showing case status and next steps is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such portal or dashboard. Visalaw AI is a drafting, research and document-analysis tool for immigration teams, not a client-facing view of case status, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product
